messages:
Ava: Hot take — eggnog > hot chocolate. Fight me. :milk_glass:
Mohan: blasphemy. Hot chocolate forever. marshmallows win every time. :hot_cocoa:
Ava: you just haven't tried rum-spiked eggnog (or the non-alc office batch). game changer. :wink:
Sam: poll time — react :christmas_tree: for eggnog, :chocolate_bar: for hot chocolate. quick and decisive.
holiday-planner-bot: Poll created: Eggnog vs Hot Chocolate — react to vote (ends in 24h)
Leah: whoa, Ava's rum argument is persuasive. also I will bring a thermos of homemade hot cocoa to the 12/22 meetup. :heart:
Ben: I'll bring the non-alc eggnog for the 18th standup — lab fridge takeover? :fridge:
Maya: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/cute-mug-spinning — this is my vote. both. :sparkles:
Carlos: hot chocolate + a pinch of cayenne is underrated. spicy marshmallows for the win.
Mohan: cayenne is cheating but also maybe brilliant. hugging both camps. :shrug:
Ava: cayenne is a war crime tbh. give me nutmeg and a cozy blanket instead. :maple_leaf:
Sam: also — side poll: cookie swap? react :cookie: if you're in. signups here: https://forms.gle/office-cookie-swap (5 slots left)
Leah: signed up. ginger snaps incoming.
Ben: can confirm the eggnog is very nonthreatening. will label all adult versions clearly. :label:
Maya: reminder: ugly sweater mini-contest at the 4pm holiday hangout next Friday. bring receipts (and snacks).
Ava: if eggnog wins, I'll wear my reindeer onesie. low bar, high commitment. :deer:
Mohan: low bar? you wore that to onboarding. I have the photo. :camera_with_flash:
Sam: we are going to auction that photo for good causes. kidding. maybe. :money_with_wings:
Leah: poll results will be posted after 24h. may the best beverage win. :trophy:
